founders_enriched.source_of_identity: Lead of FUN-CRETE project and recipient of ERC Proof of Concept grant.

inflection_why_now: The increasing demand for sustainable infrastructure solutions presents a timely opportunity for integrating energy harvesting capabilities into structural elements.
devils_advocate_risks: Technical Feasibility: Ensuring the reliable performance of cementitious composites coupled with piezoelectric polymers under real-world conditions.
Market Adoption: Convincing stakeholders in the construction and infrastructure sectors to adopt new, unproven materials and technologies.

lp_synergy_matches.reason: Evonik specializes in advanced materials and chemicals, which could complement the development of innovative cementitious composites for energy harvesting.
WACKER's expertise in chemical production and materials science aligns with the project's aim to develop functional materials for infrastructure applications.
